answers.rationale: The requirement specifies 15 kV metal-clad switchgear with specific ratings and features. The CROWN-ARMV product from the catalog matches this description as it is an arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear with vacuum circuit breakers, suitable for the specified voltage class.

The requirement specifies rigid bus bar connections for potential transformer trays, which is a feature that can be incorporated into the CROWN-ARMV product as part of its engineered-to-order offering.

The requirement describes specific features of the circuit breaker compartment and breakers, which align with the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product, including vacuum circuit breakers and compatibility with SEL-751 relays.
The requirement specifies operation on a solidly grounded 13.2 kV system, which is within the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product as an engineered-to-order solution.
The requirement for a gang-operated isolation switch can be addressed within the engineered-to-order capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product.
The requirement for specific metering CTs, VTs, and ground balls can be fulfilled using the CROWN-ACC product, which includes accessories for MV switchgear such as ground balls and other components.
The requirement for compliance with IEEE standards for metal-clad switchgear is inherently met by the CROWN-ARMV product, which is designed to meet IEEE C37.20.7 standards.
